body.x: Soulo's karaoke microphone was one of 2011's hottest "app-cessories," and now at this week's CES, Soulo is announcing the 2012 debut of new musical instruments for iOS, as well as updates to the unanimously-acclaimed Soulo app. New releases from Soulo include: Drums, keyboard, guitar, and updated Soulo mic to create an immersive user experience (all compatible with iPad, iPhone, and iPod Touch), Enhanced audio & video recording features, Holiday-themed songs and backgrounds.

Called "The coolest external gadget to come along for iOS" (The Next Web), Soulo Karaoke "can turn a touch-screen tablet into a powerful karaoke machine" (USA Today) allowing moms, dads, tech bloggers, and music lovers alike to "unleash their inner-Cher in any room" (VentureBeat).Go to 'CES 2012' Special Page
